entry.summary: Periods of heavy rain, and amounts may approach warning criteria, especially about the ranges. Chance of upgrading to a Warning: Moderate.

entry.title: Heavy Rain Watch
entry.summary: Periods of rain with some heavy falls, amounts may approach warning criteria. Localised downpours possible. Rain easing from the north this afternoon and evening. Chance of upgrading to a Warning: Low. Changes: Chance of upgrade changed to low.

entry.title: Severe Thunderstorm Warning
entry.summary:
At 04:15 pm, MetService weather radar detected severe thunderstorms near MANGAMUKA, BROADWOOD and THE MAUNGATANIWHA RANGE.
These severe thunderstorms are moving towards the east, and are expected to lie near MANGAMUKA and THE MAUNGATANIWHA RANGE at 04:45 pm and near MANGAMUKA and PUKETI FOREST at 05:15 pm.
These thunderstorms are expected to be accompanied by very heavy rain.
Impact:
Very heavy rain can cause surface and/or flash flooding about streams, gullies and urban areas, and make driving conditions extremely hazardous.
